title: Daily settlement missing
summary: the daily settlement job stopped running after a timezone configuration change

logs: scheduler WARN local time 02:00 does not exist
deployments: scheduler timezone changed UTC -> America/Los_Angeles before DST transition

runbooks.title: DST scheduling gap
runbooks.content: Jobs scheduled in local wall time can be skipped at DST transitions. Use UTC or a scheduler with explicit missed-run policy.

oracle.root_cause: The settlement cron moved to local 02:00, a nonexistent time during the DST transition.
